events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: A Game Changer
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' and changed everything. Which track from the album is still on your playlist?

events.title: John Lennon Tribute

angles.name: Imagine a Legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a voice that shaped generations. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.
